scope: Original development-01 routing Simulator stills on candidate b7 before latest-main living-light merge.
summary: Earned map sequence visibly restores Frostfruit and reveals Sunwheel with the correct title, selection marker, ready status and Visit action. Entry displays dormant Sunwheel at 0/18 with its closed outlet.
Initial Lantern entry, repaired Lantern/relaunch, Silver-to-Frostfruit readiness and Frostfruit entry retain correct location art and legible map actions.
All seven native swap/clear and quiet-corner captures show the correct restoration painting and readable actual pieces, score, dialogue and actions.
All seven Official-map-* captures correctly show the same retained Open Sky board after preview cancellation. Their names identify the cancelled preview, not the displayed restoration location.
No visible blank/missing artwork, center-clearing rectangle, cloud seam, blocking crop or unreadable action was found in these captures.

evidenceInterpretation.finding: Earned Frostfruit test first asserts Sunwheel locked; commits a native Frostfruit winning clear, then asserts Ready to restore, Frostfruit Restored and Bell Choir Not yet available. It relaunches, visits Sunwheel, begins and checks 0/18 before the entry capture.

Official-map captures are taken after selecting a map preview and cancelling with world.done; board and score are asserted unchanged. The retained historical dense Open Sky fixture explains its completed Lantern scenery and historical special.
Quiet captures use isolated dense restoration fixtures with calm effects, then a native corner clear and exact score assertion.

limitations: This report reviews stills; interaction assertions and save/relaunch behavior belong to the separately recorded 7/7 native run.
Stills with trails or quiet effects do not establish normal animation timing, fluidity, actual VoiceOver behavior or physical-device acceptance.
Candidate b7 predates the latest-main living-light merge. These captures must not be described as post-merge material or runtime acceptance.
No images were edited, recompressed, copied or rotated; original PNG bytes and orientation metadata were retained. Display previews may be scaled by the viewing tool.
The 29 routing stills do not replace the separate five-stage and tablet visual reviews.
